{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: look for thousands separators
print("First 5 values of revenue:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for non-numeric patterns
print("Unique values in revenue:", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10 unique values

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print("Revenue contains commas:", has_commas)"}
